item.title: Formula 1 drops Bahrain, Saudi Arabia races amid escalating Iran war tensions: reports
item.summary: The Formula 1 races scheduled for April in Bahrain and Saudi Arabia won’t go on as planned, according to reports. The decision comes amid the ongoing conflict involving Iran.

item.title: Iranian soccer team says 'no one can exclude' squad from 2026 World Cup amid participation doubts
item.summary: Iran's national soccer team responded to 2026 World Cup speculation, declaring "no one can exclude" it from the FIFA tournament during the ongoing conflict in the Middle East.

item.title: Hegseth announces Pentagon probe into deadly strike on Iranian school
item.summary: Pentagon investigates deadly Iran strike that Tehran regime claims killed 168+ children at school by IRGC military site. U.S. investigation is underway.

item.title: Virginia man charged with selling weapon used by Old Dominion university gunman
item.summary: A Virginia man was charged with selling the weapon used by the Old Dominion shooter on Thursday. The shooting left one instructor dead.

item.title: Live Nation employees caught calling fans 'so stupid' in shocking price-gouging messages
item.summary: Live Nation employees allegedly bragged about “robbing them blind" while referring to customers in leaked messages as the company faced a federal antitrust lawsuit.

item.title: Olympic sensation Alysa Liu opens up on withdrawing from world championships
item.summary: Alysa Liu withdrew from World Championships citing scheduling conflicts and lack of training time after her historic Olympic gold medal win and surge in social media popularity.

item.title: Planned Parenthood attacks Hawley's effort to strip FDA approval of mifepristone
item.summary: Sen. Josh Hawley introduced legislation to revoke FDA approval of the abortion drug mifepristone, sparking strong criticism from Planned Parenthood officials.

item.title: Trump-backed voter ID bill faces GOP resistance as Tillis vows to stop it
item.summary: Senate Republicans are ready for a floor battle over a voter ID bill despite internal divisions, with Sens. Thom Tillis , R-N.C., and Lisa Murkowski, R-Alaska, in opposition.

item.title: 'Access Hollywood' canceled after 30 years
item.summary: "Access Hollywood" is being canceled by NBCUniversal as part of a company's broader plan to roll back on syndicated programming, marking the end of an era for daytime television.

item.title: Texas judge who played victim card booted from rodeo grounds a second time following VIP seating dispute
item.summary: Harris County Judge Lina Hidalgo is feuding with the Houston Rodeo board after a VIP seating dispute at NRG Stadium after she was escorted out of the venue.
